measurement.build: cargo test --release -p st3 --lib; Nix Rust 1.97.0 / LLVM 21.1.8
measurement.scope: Isolated WAL API daemon; 128 seats, delivery and title streams per seat; no providers or reconciler; separate load process. Same fixture on both versions.
measurement.latency_scope: API request start to recipient mailbox frame or old-owner fenced frame. CPU covers all 3000 writes and a 300ms settle, excluding setup, doctor and ownership replacement phase.
measurement.counter_scope: before/after and doctor counters are rolling five-minute snapshots; sampled durations differ and are not full-run deltas.
